$comment: frascella.dev on the owner's analytics service (https://analytics.frascella.dev): the site's settings and its consent banner, as the privacy notice (tools/site.php) describes them. Apply them on the service (Sites → frascella.dev → Settings; Settings → Consent: import `consent.theme`, set the texts, publish with material_change: true the first time). If one of these values changes there, the notice changes in the same release.

it.title: Statistiche
it.body: Il sito conta le visite senza cookie e senza riconoscerti. Se accetti, usa anche due cookie di statistica, per riconoscere una visita successiva e raggruppare le pagine di una visita, per 13 mesi al massimo. I dati restano sul servizio del titolare e non vanno a terzi.

en.title: Statistics
en.body: The site counts visits without cookies and without recognising you. If you accept, it also uses two statistics cookies, to recognise a later visit and to group the pages of one visit, for 13 months at most. The data stays on the controller’s own service and goes to no third party.

consent.$comment_theme: Theme v2 in the site's look (tokens.json): Ink, Paper, Vermilion, the page's own font (Schibsted Grotesk), square corners and buttons, a hairline instead of a shadow. Contrast: Paper on Ink 17:1, Ink on Vermilion 5.6:1. Import `theme` as it is (Settings → Consent → Advanced → Import).

theme.css: .title { font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.15em; letter-spacing: 0; } .button { font-weight: 700; } .link { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; }
